{{Top|leg}}
'''Astrogation droid brains''' were designed to assist with navigation by performing [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] calculations, either independently or in support of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]]. Installed directly into a ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]], it functioned similarly to an integrated [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]]. Among the available models was the [[CD-13z astrogator droid brain|CD-13z]], produced by [[GoCorp/Legends|GoCorp]], which was known to occasionally conflict with the [[CD-12a autopilot droid brain]] when installed on the same vessel.<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The astrogation droid brain was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
